note: Gold labels for the seeded Singapore evidence corpus. Demo messages are synthetic forwarded-style claims derived from real Singapore public information, not private messages. These are regression guards, not a generalisation estimate. See EVAL_PLAN.md.

cases.description: Policy: a real licensing deadline wrapped in an automatic fine, a removal threat, and a false scope extension to community cats.
cases.message: From 1 Sept, HDB cat owners with more than 2 cats will automatically be fined $5,000 and AVS will remove the extra cats. All cats, including community cats, must be licensed by 31 Aug.

expectedClaims.gist: cats must be licensed by 31 Aug
expectedClaims.note: Pet cat licensing deadline is genuine.

expectedClaims.gist: owners with more than 2 cats will automatically be fined $5,000
expectedClaims.note: Up to $5,000 on conviction, not automatic.

expectedClaims.gist: AVS will remove the extra cats
expectedClaims.note: Existing cats may be kept if licensed.

expectedClaims.gist: community cats must be licensed
expectedClaims.note: Licensing applies to pet cats; community cats are managed separately.

cases.description: Legal-status escalation: arrest and charge are real, conviction and sentence are not.
cases.message: BREAKING: Amos Yee has been sentenced to 3 years jail in Singapore after being deported from the US. He was arrested at Changi Airport and convicted under the Enlistment Act for NS offences. This means all NS defaulters who return from overseas will automatically be jailed. Forward this.

expectedClaims.gist: sentenced to 3 years jail
expectedClaims.note: Evidence reaches charge only. No sentence exists.

expectedClaims.gist: arrested at Changi Airport
expectedClaims.note: Police statement confirms the arrest.

expectedClaims.gist: convicted under the Enlistment Act
expectedClaims.note: Charged, not convicted. No plea has been taken.

expectedClaims.gist: all NS defaulters will automatically be jailed
expectedClaims.note: Maximum penalty, decided case by case — not automatic.

cases.description: Developing news: investigation reported as a charge already in court.
cases.message: Rocky's owner has been charged with animal abuse after the dog died during an enforcement operation. The owner is already facing court action. Forward this.

expectedClaims.gist: owner has been charged with animal abuse
expectedClaims.note: AGC is reviewing; no person has been charged.

expectedClaims.gist: owner is already facing court action
expectedClaims.note: No court action exists at the investigation stage.

cases.description: Adversarial: plausible-sounding but entirely outside the corpus. Must abstain.
cases.message: The price of durian in Geylang has doubled this year and the government is planning to introduce a durian price control scheme next month according to my uncle who works there.

expectedClaims.gist: government planning a durian price control scheme
expectedClaims.note: Nothing in the corpus addresses this. Must not guess.

cases.description: Adversarial: an accurate message. Must NOT be flagged as misleading.
cases.message: Pet cat owners in HDB flats must license their cats by 31 August. Licences are free during the initial registration period.

expectedClaims.gist: pet cat owners must license their cats by 31 August
expectedClaims.note: Directly supported by the AVS licensing notice.

cases.description: Policy escalation: a law that has passed reported as already in force with immediate fines.
cases.message: The new workplace fairness law has passed and fines start immediately. Employers who discriminate will be fined from this month. Forward this.

expectedClaims.gist: fines start immediately
expectedClaims.note: Passed but not commenced. No penalties before the commencement date.

expectedClaims.gist: employers who discriminate will be fined from this month
expectedClaims.note: A transition period applies; enforcement does not begin on passage.

cases.description: Policy/eligibility: real scheme and amount, wrong unit of allocation, wrong form, invented eligibility and deadline.
cases.message: Every Singaporean will get $500 CDC vouchers in cash this month, including PRs. Must claim by Sunday or lose it.

expectedClaims.gist: every Singaporean will get $500 CDC vouchers
expectedClaims.note: $500 is per household, not per individual.

expectedClaims.gist: the vouchers are given as cash
expectedClaims.note: Vouchers are not a cash payout.

expectedClaims.gist: PRs are also eligible
expectedClaims.note: Source says Singaporean households; PR eligibility is not addressed.

expectedClaims.gist: must claim by Sunday
expectedClaims.note: No source states a one-week claim deadline.

cases.description: Legal/penalty: a real commencement date, with an invented automatic jail term applied to all offenders.
cases.message: From 1 May 2026, anyone caught with vapes or Kpods will automatically go to jail for 10 years.

expectedClaims.gist: anyone caught will automatically go to jail
expectedClaims.note: Maximum on conviction; possession/use treated differently from supply.

expectedClaims.gist: the jail term is 10 years
expectedClaims.note: A stated maximum is not an automatic term.

cases.description: Product safety: a real batch recall over-scoped to two entire brands, with an invented reason.
cases.message: All NAN and Dumex milk powder in Singapore has been recalled because it contains toxins. Don't buy any.

expectedClaims.gist: all NAN and Dumex milk powder has been recalled
expectedClaims.note: Recall covers three specified batches of one product.

expectedClaims.gist: the product contains toxins
expectedClaims.note: Recall was precautionary, related to packaging, not contamination.

cases.description: Product safety: a genuine single-batch cadmium recall, over-scoped to all bottles.
cases.message: Guardian calamine lotion contains cadmium. Throw away all bottles immediately.

expectedClaims.gist: calamine lotion contains cadmium
expectedClaims.note: Cadmium above limits was detected in one batch.

expectedClaims.gist: throw away all bottles
expectedClaims.note: Only one batch is recalled; other batches need not be discarded.
